evidence: Created "QA Full Product" (all fields incl. category, image, affiliate link, tags, specs, featured) and edited Sony WH-1000XM5 (price, description, tags) via admin; changes appeared immediately on /products, /category/*, home, and detail pages via client-side navigation.

issue: Featured collection capped, no complete browsable set
actual: Marked "QA Full Product" featured (4th featured item total); homepage "Featured" widget still showed only the original 3 items. "View all" from Featured links to /products (unfiltered, no featured filter available), and /featured route does not exist (shows not-found). Visitors cannot browse the complete set of featured products.

evidence: Search "SONY" (uppercase) matched name case-insensitively; search "exceptional sound" matched description; search "renamedtag" matched tag; each returned correct product with accurate "1 product found" count.

issue: New tag on existing product not added to filter list
actual: Added tag "uniquetagxyz" to Sony WH-1000XM5 via admin edit; tag correctly appeared on the product detail page, but the products page's tag-filter list (Filters panel) did not include "uniquetagxyz" as a selectable option, so it cannot be chosen as a filter.

evidence: Created "Tag Search Test Product" with new tags "brandnewtagxyz, secondtagabc"; both tags appeared on product detail page and searching "brandnewtagxyz" returned the product (1 product found).

On Sony WH-1000XM5: added tag "uniquetagxyz" (appeared on detail page), then renamed it to "renamedtag" and removed "premium" (detail page tags updated to headphones/wireless/noise-cancelling/renamedtag); search for "renamedtag" found the product.
Created "QA Full Product" with category Fitness; Fitness category product count on homepage updated from 3 to 4 products, and product appeared in Fitness category filter results.
On /products, selecting category "Fitness" in the filter dropdown updated result count to "4 products found" showing only Fitness items (QA Full Product, Bowflex, Theragun, Peloton).
All 9 seeded products listed on /products, each article shows category badge, name (heading link), price, star rating, brief description paragraph, image, and a "Buy Now" purchase action link.

Verified sorts: Price Low-High (129.99→2495 ascending), Price High-Low (2495→199 descending), Top Rated (4.9→4.3 descending), Newest (newly created product appeared first). Verified filters: min-rating "4.5+ stars" returned exactly the 8 products rated ≥4.5; price minimum slider set to $1000 returned exactly the 3 products priced ≥$1000.

issue: Admin changes not persisted across reload
actual: After creating "Minimal Test Product" and editing Sony's price to $349 (both visible immediately in-session), reloading /products via full navigation reverted the product list to the original 9 seeded products and Sony's price back to $399. All admin creations/edits are lost on page reload, indicating changes are only held in client-side memory, not persisted to a backend/storage.

evidence: Every product card and detail page shows exactly one category badge (Tech, Home, or Fitness); admin form category is a single-select control with exactly the three supported categories.

Selecting tags "wireless"+"laptop" returned exactly MacBook Pro (laptop) and Sony (wireless), each satisfying at least one selected tag (OR logic). Combined category/price/rating filters each produced result sets matching all active criteria (e.g., Fitness+rating 4.5+ etc. all verified accurate).

issue: Products can be published without required content
actual: Created "Minimal Test Product" with only Name and Short Description filled in (price left at $0, no rating change, no image URL, no affiliate/retailer link, no specifications). The product was successfully created and immediately published to the live product catalog (appeared on /products, detail page) despite missing image, retailer link, and specifications, and having a $0 price.

evidence: Navigating to /product/nonexistent-product-xyz shows "Product Not Found" with a "Browse All Products" link; /category/nonexistent-category shows "Category Not Found" with clear message. Neither displays unrelated product data.
Typing in search box, selecting tag filters, changing sort/category/rating/price all updated the product grid and count instantly without any manual page reload throughout testing.
Clicking product image link and clicking product name heading link both navigate to the same /product/<slug> detail page for that product (verified for Sony WH-1000XM5 and Apple MacBook Pro 14").
"Buy Now" link on MacBook Pro detail page has href="https://example.com/macbook-pro", target="_blank", rel="noopener noreferrer" — opens external retailer in a new tab.

issue: Category dropdown non-functional on category pages
actual: On /category/tech, the page offers its own category filter dropdown. Selecting "Home Goods" from this dropdown left the active category displayed as "Tech Gadgets" and the product grid unchanged (still showing the 3 Tech products), i.e. choosing a different category on this control does not update the active category or displayed products. (The equivalent dropdown on /products works correctly.)

evidence: Sony WH-1000XM5 and MacBook Pro detail pages display matching name, category, rating, price, brief description, full review, tags, key specifications, image, and a retailer "Buy Now" action, consistent with admin/catalog data.

Seeded products use relevant tags/categories, e.g. Sony WH-1000XM5 (Tech: headphones, wireless, noise-cancelling, premium), MacBook Pro (Tech: laptop, apple, professional, portable); these are consistent between the products list/category view and the detail view.

MacBook Pro 14" shows identical name/category/price($1,999)/rating(4.9)/description across /products list and detail page. Detail page review text (verified via DOM textContent) is the full untruncated paragraph, and all 5 key specifications are listed in full (no truncation), despite the compact semantic snapshot summarizing long text with an ellipsis for brevity only.
